basics.name: Riccardo Bergamin
basics.label: Data Scientist
basics.summary: Data Scientist with a PhD in Theoretical Physics and experience developing mathematical, probabilistic, and statistical models for complex data-driven problems. My research background combines Bayesian inference, stochastic modelling, machine learning, and scientific software development, with applications in computational genomics and translational cancer research. More recently, I have developed an interest in football analytics, applying quantitative methods to event and tracking data. Interested in research-driven opportunities where mathematical modelling and data science can contribute to understanding complex systems and solving practical problems.

work.name: University of Trieste
work.summary: Research in computational genomics, cancer evolution, and probabilistic modelling.
highlights: Developed Bayesian and stochastic modelling frameworks to reconstruct cancer evolutionary histories and infer the timing of genomic events using longitudinal whole-genome sequencing data.
Applied evolutionary timing models to translational research questions, investigating the relationship between clonal dynamics, treatment history, and therapeutic resistance.
Developed probabilistic models to investigate phenotypic heterogeneity and the evolutionary dynamics of prognostic markers using genomic and spatial transcriptomic data.
Contributed to the development of computational genomics tools, reproducible analysis pipelines, and benchmarking workflows.
Mentored Master's and PhD students and taught computational genomics classes.
